findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_fragrances" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Resolve a fragrance name to catalogue entries. Call this FIRST whenever a name is partial, misspelled, or could mean more than one product, then pass the return…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_fragrances · Public sink: search_fragrances, compare_fragrances.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_fragrances · Public sink: search_fragrances, compare_fragrances

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
